newsitem.title: USA: MEHL/Biophile names new chief fin officer.
newsitem.headline: MEHL/Biophile names new chief fin officer.

text.p: MEHL/Biophile International Corp said on Wednesday it has named Tim Chapple as chief financial officer.
Most recently, Chapple, who joined the company in August 1996, has been chief financial officer and managing director of SLS Biophile Ltd, a majority owned MEHL subsidiary.
He succeeds Raymond Wilson, who resigned to "pursue other business interests", the company said.
MEHL/Biophile is a technology transfer company concentrating on hair removal and cosmetic dermatological products.
